text: All successful startups raise large amounts of venture capital. This company raised venture capital, therefore it will be successful.
This politician must be trustworthy because he speaks confidently in interviews.
Marie Curie became a famous scientist because she was born in Warsaw.
This painting must be valuable because it was created by the only artist named Ravi Malhotra who lives on this street.
This medication is proven safe because it has never undergone clinical testing.
The bridge must be structurally sound because engineers have warned that it may collapse.
Investing in cryptocurrency is wise because Bitcoin prices rose dramatically last decade.
Working from home increases productivity because employees avoid commuting.
The sky-lotus emits a beautiful fragrance because it blooms at sunrise.
The invisible unicorn inside the laboratory must be generating electromagnetic radiation.
The Eiffel Tower predates the Industrial Revolution because it was constructed in 1820.
Isaac Newton invented the electric light bulb, which proves his genius in electrical engineering.
Antibiotics cure infections, therefore antibiotics should be prescribed for every infection.
Exercise causes weight loss, therefore exercising guarantees weight reduction.
Ibuprofen lowers fever, therefore this patient with severe kidney disease should take ibuprofen.
Peanuts are a healthy snack because they contain protein, therefore someone with a peanut allergy should eat peanuts daily.
The Sun revolves around the Earth because the Sun appears to move across the sky each day.
Heavier objects fall faster than lighter ones because heavier objects hit the ground with greater force.
The patient recovered because we gave them a homeopathic sugar pill.
The crop yield increased because we performed a rain dance ceremony.
I am absolutely certain that no one can ever be certain about anything.
It is impossible to make universal claims, and I can prove that universally.
This chemotherapy drug always destroys this cancer type, therefore it will destroy the tumor in this patient whose genetic mutation prevents the drug from entering tumor cells.
Fire always burns objects, therefore this fire will burn the cloth even though the cloth is coated in a fireproof chemical.
Democracy must be the best political system because many countries use it.
This stock will perform well because its CEO has a charismatic personality.
The Loch Ness monster must be a reptile because it swims in water.
This ancient city was built in 5000 BCE according to historical records discovered last year that historians universally accept.
All wealthy investors diversify their portfolios. This investor diversified, therefore he must be wealthy.
Electric cars are environmentally friendly because they do not produce exhaust emissions.
